title: Earlybird: Predictive Streaming Speech Recognition in 29M Parameters
abstract: arXiv:2611.14421v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Streaming speech recognizers output a word only after the speaker has finished it, typically 90-400 ms later. For a voice agent every millisecond counts: the sooner the words are outputted, the sooner the agent can start a search or plan its reply. We present Earlybird, a 29M-parameter streaming recognizer (16.8 MB at 4 bits). Earlybird learns from audio cut off at random points, including partway through a word, and is asked to predict every word that is due by then in full, plus a guess of the next two words. Its raw token probabilities give a confidence for every word including the one still being spoken. On clean audiobook speech (LibriSpeech test-clean), the median word is predicted correctly 90 ms before the speaker finishes it, while released streaming models get it 90 to 400 ms after it ends. Earlybird is the earliest on all six test sets we time, covering audiobooks, TED talks, public speech, earnings calls, and synthetic spee

translated_title: Earlybird：2900万参数的预测式流式语音识别
translated_abstract: 流式语音识别器通常要等到说话者说完一个词之后才能输出该词，一般延迟90至400毫秒。对于语音代理而言，每一毫秒都至关重要：词语输出得越早，代理就能越早开始搜索或规划回复。我们提出了Earlybird，一个仅有2900万参数的流式识别器（4比特量化下仅16.8 MB）。Earlybird从随机截断的音频中学习，包括在词语说到一半时被截断的音频，并被要求完整预测到该时刻为止所有应当输出的词，同时额外猜测接下来的两个词。其原始token概率为每个词（包括仍在发音中的词）提供了置信度。在清晰的有声读物语音（LibriSpeech test-clean）上，中位词能在说话者说完之前90毫秒就被正确预测，而已发布的流式模型则需要在词结束后90至400毫秒才能输出。在我们计时的涵盖有声读物、TED演讲、公开演讲、财报电话会议和合成语音的全部六个测试集上，Earlybird都是输出最早的模型。
tldr: Earlybird是一个仅2900万参数的预测式流式语音识别模型，通过在随机截断的音频上学习预测词语，能在说话者说完中位词之前约90毫秒就正确输出，比现有流式模型提前99至490毫秒。
en_tdlr: Earlybird is a 29M-parameter predictive streaming speech recognizer trained on randomly truncated audio that correctly outputs the median word 90 ms before the speaker finishes it, outpacing existing streaming models by 99-490 ms.
